description: This file defines the URL class, a GUI component extending JLabel that displays a URL as a clickable link with an underline, and handles mouse click events to open the URL in a browser. It is part of a larger project related to RomRaider, an open-source tuning and reflashing tool for automotive ECUs.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: A GUI component representing a clickable URL label that underlines the URL text and opens the URL in the default browser upon click.

methods.name: URL
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the URL label with the specified URL string, sets font, and adds mouse listener.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Overrides the paint method to draw an underline beneath the URL text.

methods.name: mouseClicked
methods.description: Handles mouse click events by invoking BrowserControl.displayURL to open the URL.

methods.name: mousePressed
methods.description: No implementation; part of MouseListener interface.

methods.name: mouseReleased
methods.description: No implementation; part of MouseListener interface.

methods.name: mouseEntered
methods.description: No implementation; part of MouseListener interface.

methods.name: mouseExited
methods.description: No implementation; part of MouseListener interface.
